Author: Arty
Name: RollTracker
TestingChangelog: Testing fixes: Standard is now the default UI layout, and the Truth or Dare tab now shows the missing Not enough players text fields for normal ToD and both Double ToD fallback fields in Modern and Standard layouts.
Description:
Reads chat messages, detects /random rolls, tracks Truth or Dare rounds, and provides configurable !truth, !dare, !help, !tod2, and !wifi helpers.

Commands:
/rt - open or close the window.
/rt help - show the full command and trigger list locally.
Punchline: Tracks /random rolls for private round games.
